Les collecteurs de données suivent des itinéraires prédéfinis, en se concentrant sur les rues publiques, les zones commerciales et les points d’intérêt. Pour assurer la meilleure qualité d’image, certaines zones devront être revisitées lors de conditions météorologiques favorables.

Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG - the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

ABOUT THE JOB

Most product marketers spend their careers making an average product sound better than it is. This role is the opposite.

We have built something rare: AI infrastructure that CPG teams genuinely love and will not give up. The stickiness is real, and category leaders keep choosing us. What we have not done yet is tell the world why we are better, and that gap is wide.

Today our positioning, customer proof, and competitive story are spread thin across the team. Our product is ahead of its story, and you close that gap. You own how our products show up in the market: how each area is positioned, why we win, and how we turn product and customer moments into demand. You power the GTM team with a story sharp enough to sell on, and you help define the category we are building.

This is a founding role. You are one of the first PMMs at Confido, here early enough to shape how the whole function works. Product Marketing reports to the VP of Marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You own strategy, programming, and the moments: what gets said, to whom, and where. This is a role for someone who wants to make the thing, not brief it out.

Own

- Positioning, messaging, and narrative for the platform, sharpened as the product evolves

- Product-market clarity: the ICP, buyer, user, jobs to be done, alternatives, and why customers expand

- Product launches end to end: the plan, narrative, and cross-functional orchestration that turn new features into pipeline

- The customer-insight engine: lightweight automations (Gong, HubSpot, Zapier) that turn calls and win/loss into the themes, quotes, and proof that feed positioning and competitive intel

- GTM enablement: the battlecards, and messaging that arm reps to win

- Case studies and customer proof, sourced, written, and deployed into Sales hands at the right moment

- An integrated plan connecting the product roadmap to the marketing calendar across lifecycle, social, partnerships, AEO, and brand moments

HOW YOU'RE MEASURED

We measure product marketing on the pipeline it moves and the deals it wins, not on activity.

- Deal velocity and win rate (primary). Sharp positioning and enablement move qualified deals faster and beat the alternatives more often

- Influenced pipeline and its trajectory. Every deal maps to one of five motions: inbound, outbound, referral, partnerships, upsell. The signal that matters most is trajectory: the share of pipeline we build rather than rent, growing over time

- Launch impact. New products are measured on adoption and the pipeline they generate, not on shipping

- Enablement effectiveness. Reps are equipped, using your assets, and able to defend against competitors in live deals

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 7+ years in product marketing. This is a clear PMM role, and we want someone who has done the craft, not an adjacent function

- Ideally in one of two worlds: CPG or commerce software, building the workflows our customers already live in, or B2B technology, where you translated genuinely complex products into clear entry points

- Excellent writing and narrative instincts. You turn a complex product into sharp, credible positioning

- Financial and quantitative fluency: comfortable reporting on pipeline influence and deal velocity

- Strong cross-functional project management, and the judgment to build enough structure without slowing the work down

- Willingness to work at our NYC Headquarters 5 days a week

- Manage multiple projects at once, prioritising effectively across competing issues

Essential

- Bachelor's Degree (Marketing or Business preferred) or strong relevant experience

- 2-4 years email application experience

- CRM / campaign management platform experience

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

- Good communication and stakeholder management skills

- Experience building automated CRM programmes

- Experience using data visualisation tools & reporting

- Highly computer literate with:

- AI utilisation

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

We are looking for an AI Agent Security Architect to function as the primary technical

authority for Replit’s autonomous and AI agent security blueprint. In this critical role, you

will design, implement, and maintain the runtime defense systems, guardrail

frameworks, and sandboxing architectures that govern AI agents executing code,

invoking tools, and reasoning across our platform. You will be a key technical

contributor-leading high-impact AI security initiatives and bridging the gap between

non-deterministic AI behavior and rigorous cybersecurity controls for both engineering

and executive leadership.

What You'll Do

- AI Agent Security Strategy & Technical Execution

- AI Agent Security Blueprint: Define the long-term vision and architectural patterns for securing autonomous agent workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, multi-turn reasoning loops, and multi-agent coordination.

- Runtime Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Architect and deploy dynamic input/output guardrail systems, semantic firewalls, and real-time intent verification filters to prevent goal hijacking, system prompt leaks, and indirect prompt injections.

- Agent Execution & Tool Sandboxing: Partner with Infrastructure and AppSec teams to design secure, short-lived, micro-isolated environments (e.g., microVMs, WebAssembly, container sandboxes) where agents can dynamically execute code, run shell commands, and interact with host operating systems safely.

- Agentic Threat Modeling & Red Teaming: Conduct specialized threat modeling against non-deterministic systems. Lead automated and manual AI red-teaming initiatives to uncover vulnerabilities in RAG context pipelines, vector stores, and tool-calling interfaces.

- Identity, Delegation & Least Privilege: Architect fine-grained permission models and step-up Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) authorization patterns for agents acting on behalf of users-ensuring agents never exceed the delegated privileges of the end user or misuse API keys.

- Context & Memory Boundary Security: Design strict data isolation and poisoning prevention controls for vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and long-term conversation memories across multi-tenant workloads.

- Risk Management & Cross-Functional Enablement

- Maintain the AI Security Source of Truth: Define, document, and maintain authoritative secure design patterns and SDKs for engineering teams building internal or customer-facing AI agent capabilities.

- Contribution to Risk Register: Identify, quantify, and document non-deterministic and agentic security risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, MITRE ATLAS), ensuring they are accurately represented in the Cybersecurity Risk Register.

- Auditability & Observability: Design tamper-evident logging and telemetry standards for agent reasoning chains, tool execution history, and context assembly to support incident response, forensics, and GRC requirements.

- Compliance & Sales Enablement: Partner with GRC to translate complex AI security controls into enterprise-ready audit documentation (e.g., ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act readiness) and support Sales on complex enterprise security inquiries regarding AI safety.

Required Skills & Experience

- 6+ years of experience in security engineering or security architecture, with at least 2+ years dedicated specifically to AI/ML security, LLM application security, or securing agentic frameworks.
